description: Find and repair the root cause preventing mission objectives from driving Runtime execution.
global_rules: Continue until root cause is identified or governance blocks execution.
Use available AI capabilities only when they provide additional value.
Validate every proposed fix before applying it.
Record every decision, finding and proof.

objectives.goal: Trace the complete mission lifecycle from Mission Interpreter to Patch Executor.
Verify that roadmap objectives are actually loaded and preserved.
done_when: Mission objectives verified after Mission Loader.

objectives.goal: Verify whether Execution Planner consumes mission objectives.
Determine why Decision Engine always generates identical actions.
Verify Patch Engine and Patch Executor receive mission-specific actions.
Repair the broken connection preventing mission-driven execution.
done_when: Generic hardcoded execution removed where appropriate.

objectives.goal: Validate the repair using multiple different missions.

definition_of_done: Root cause repaired or explicitly justified if not repairable.
completion: Runtime executes mission objectives instead of generic actions.
Decision Engine behavior changes according to mission content.
